WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS per_day_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
avg_per_day AS (
  SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS plain_avg_per_day
  FROM rating_stats
)
SELECT 
  rs.rating,
  rs.avg_replacement_cost,
  rs.per_day_price,
  rs.per_day_price / apd.plain_avg_per_day AS ratio_to_plain_avg
FROM rating_stats rs
CROSS JOIN avg_per_day apd
ORDER BY rs.rating
